scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @pitwall/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @pitwall/ui check
scripts.test:ui: pnpm gen && pnpm gen:moments && pnpm --filter @pitwall/ui build && VITE_PITWALL_GALLERY=1 pnpm --filter @pitwall/ui build --outDir dist-e2e && pnpm --filter @pitwall/desktop build && playwright test -c apps/ui/playwright.config.ts
scripts.mutation: pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter @pitwall/protocol --filter @pitwall/engine --filter @pitwall/analysis run mutation && pnpm --dir apps/ui exec stryker run
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm depcruise && pnpm test
scripts.gen: pnpm gen:features && pnpm gen:topics && pnpm gen:widgets && pnpm gen:catalogue
scripts.pitwall: pnpm -s gen:features && pnpm -s gen:topics && pnpm -s gen:widgets && node scripts/gen-catalogue.ts --no-fail && node apps/bridge/src/cli/pitwall.ts
